vref_dc.source: VREF is half of +2V8 (R3, R4): a value outside means ngspice settled on a false operating point

ctout_dc.source: U3 follows VREF at DC (C15 blocks its input): the same check on the integrator

att_50.source: README, What it must do: at least 3 dB less noise at 50 Hz

att_100.source: README, What it must do: at least 8 dB less noise at 100 Hz

att_200.source: README, What it must do: at least 12 dB less noise from 200 to 300 Hz

att_300.source: README, What it must do: at least 12 dB less noise from 200 to 300 Hz

att_500.source: README, What it must do: at least 6 dB less noise at 500 Hz

s_peak.source: README, What it must do: no frequency louder by more than 6 dB. A sensitivity peak Ms of 2 guarantees a gain margin of Ms/(Ms-1) = 2 and a phase margin of 2 asin(1/(2 Ms)) = 29 degrees
